create_mip_ray_marcher: create a MipRayMarcher2 instance with an activation factory for volume rendering
run_forward_ray_marcher: run the MipRayMarcher2 forward pass to composite colors and depths from raw rendering outputs
compute_volume_rendering: compute volume rendering using the MipRayMarcher2 to produce composited RGB colors and depths
apply_activation_to_densities: apply an activation factory to density values before computing ray marching weights
composite_depth_with_weights: composite depth values using per-sample weights from the MipRayMarcher2 volume rendering
